'''Quanta sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] until his assignment to the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Tinnel IV/Legends|Tinnel IV]], ostensibly the sector seat given the location of Jerjerrod's private residence there.
